The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

I checked both pages of the category. There are five five-star books in total:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

Page 2 has no next link, so it is the last page. My own tab (t1) is still open on page 2 of the category. While I worked, the session's active tab switched to another agent's tab, so I switched back to t1 and didn't touch the others.

tool_input.command:
S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; cat <<'EOF' | agent-browser --session $S eval --stdin
(async()=>{let out=[];let url=location.href;while(url){const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await (await fetch(url)).text(),'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('article.product_pod').forEach(a=>out.push([a.querySelector('p.star-rating').className,a.querySelector('h3 a').title,a.querySelector('.price_color').textContent]));const n=d.querySelector('li.next a');url=n?new URL(n.getAttribute('href'),url).href:null}return out.filter(x=>x[0].includes('Five'))})()
EOF

cat > /tmp/q.js <<'EOF'
(async()=>{let out=[];let url=location.href;while(url){const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await (await fetch(url)).text(),'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('article.product_pod').forEach(a=>out.push([a.querySelector('p.star-rating').className,a.querySelector('h3 a').title,a.querySelector('.price_color').textContent]));const n=d.querySelector('li.next a');url=n?new URL(n.getAttribute('href'),url).href:null}return out.filter(x=>x[0].includes('Five'))})()
EOF
echo ok

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin.org/post accepted it. The response echoed back these form values:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

I set the delivery time by writing the value straight into the time input with a script, because clicking the time fields didn't work.

The response page is still open in the tab I opened myself. I left the other tabs, which belong to other agents, alone.

agents.answer:
The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, says "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!" It's still open in my own tab (t3).

- **Login:** I logged in as standard_user.
- **Sort:** I sorted the products by Price (low to high).
- **Cart:** I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light.
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The item total was $39.98, tax $3.20 and the total $43.18.

My ordinary mouse clicks on the product buttons didn't register, so I triggered the add-to-cart, checkout, continue and finish buttons with in-page JavaScript instead. I typed the form fields normally.

The browser already had other agents' tabs open (books.toscrape.com and httpbin.org). I opened my own tab and didn't use theirs.
